serverInfo.name: abstractinator
serverInfo.title: The Abstractinator
serverInfo.description: Immunology and virology literature search across Europe PMC, OpenAlex, ClinicalTrials.gov, bioRxiv/medRxiv, NIH RePORTER grants and NSF awards, deduplicated and tagged by immune cell type, virus and bacterium.

tools.name: search_literature
tools.description: Search immunology/virology literature across six biomedical databases at once. Returns deduplicated, source-balanced records tagged by immune cell type, virus and bacterium.

tools.name: get_fulltext
tools.description: Read the full text of one open-access article from Europe PMC, given a pmcid from a search result (or a DOI). Returns clean JATS section text. Paywalled articles return status not_open_access rather than an error.
